def: The metadata object on MCP requests, results and notifications, keyed by namespaced names such as io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion; prefixes whose second label is modelcontextprotocol or mcp are reserved.
practice: Since 2026-07-28 every request carries its protocol version and client capabilities here, plus optional client info, log level, progress token and OpenTelemetry trace context such as traceparent.
